metadata.title: Palantir Holds the Edge Ahead of Earnings

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Palantir (PLTR, Financials), the artificial intelligence software company, appears to enter earnings season with stronger momentum than Super Micro Computer, according to recent analyst commentary. Both companies have benefited from growing AI investment, but analysts believe Palantir is better positioned to deliver another strong quarterly performance.
Palantir to announce second-quarter earnings on Aug. 3. Wall Street anticipates revenue to climb 81 percent from a year ago to roughly $1.81 billion and earnings to rise to $0.34 a share from $0.16. Analysts also expect the company's U.S. commercial and government sectors to remain strong, with some forecasters predicting another bump up to full-year projections.
Super Micro Computer will release fourth-quarter fiscal 2026 results on Aug. 11. Analysts forecast sales of $11.6 billion, a jump of more than 100% from last year, fueled by robust demand for AI servers and a record backlog above $60 billion. Still, other analysts are skeptical, citing memory shortages and building delays that could hamper near-term execution.
Both businesses have Moderate Buy average ratings and similar upside potential based on analyst price targets. However, most recent analyst commentary indicates Palantir has the more enticing position coming into earnings, with expectations for further sales growth and another probable forecast boost.
Now investors will be looking for Palantir and Super Micro to achieve lofty expectations and cement their place in the growing AI business.
